import json, glob
from openpyxl import load_workbook

print('manifest:', open('inputs/manifest.json').read()[:800] if __import__('os').path.exists('inputs/manifest.json') else 'none')
paths = sorted(glob.glob('inputs/*.xls*'))
print('files:', paths)
p = paths[0]
wf = load_workbook(p, data_only=False)
wv = load_workbook(p, data_only=True)
print('sheets:', wf.sheetnames)
for name in wf.sheetnames:
    sf, sv = wf[name], wv[name]
    print('---', name, 'dims', sf.dimensions, 'max_row', sf.max_row, 'max_col', sf.max_column)
    for r in range(1, min(sf.max_row, 14) + 1):
        row = []
        for c in range(1, min(sf.max_column, 4) + 1):
            cf = sf.cell(r, c)
            cv = sv.cell(r, c).value
            row.append({'cell': cf.coordinate, 'formula': cf.value, 'cached': cv, 'fmt': cf.number_format, 'type': cf.data_type})
        print(row)

# cross check on Export
se, sv = wf['Export'], wv['Export']
carts = {wv['Counts'].cell(r,1).value: wv['Counts'].cell(r,2).value for r in range(2, wv['Counts'].max_row+1)}
pack = {wv['Pack factors'].cell(r,1).value: wv['Pack factors'].cell(r,2).value for r in range(2, wv['Pack factors'].max_row+1)}
print('counts keys', list(carts.items())[:4], 'pack sample', list(pack.items())[:4])
for r in range(2, se.max_row+1):
    sku = sv.cell(r,1).value
    cached = sv.cell(r,3).value
    formula = se.cell(r,3).value
    c = carts.get(sku); pk = pack.get(sku)
    calc = (c*pk) if (c is not None and pk is not None) else None
    print(sku, 'formula=', formula, 'cached=', cached, 'cartons=', c, 'pack=', pk, 'calc=', calc, 'diff=', (cached-calc) if (cached is not None and calc is not None) else None)
